capabilities: Remove [ ] or [x] checkbox formatting from the current line via a hotkey
Convert task lines back to standard bullet list items or plain text
Preserve the line's indentation when removing the checkbox
extras: The command must be assigned a hotkey manually in Settings > Hotkeys before it can be used; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in shortcut to strip checkbox syntax from a task line once it is no longer needed as a task.
summary: Hotkey command that removes task checkbox formatting ([ ] or [x]) from the current line, turning it back into a bullet list item.
